# The six molds

Choose one before the outline and say which. The mold decides what the middle of the drawing is.

| Mold | When it fits | The middle of the drawing | A value to move? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Measure and formula | A quantity that follows a rule (interest, Pythagoras, speed) | The real thing measured, then the rule drawn over it | Yes: the quantity |
| Thought experiment | "What if…" ideas (Plato's cave, the trolley) | The situation, then the twist that shows the idea | Rarely |
| Argument | A claim with reasons and an objection (stoicism, a policy) | Premises → conclusion, the objection beside it | No |
| System | Parts that pass something along (a web request, a queue) | One request followed end to end, failures included | Sometimes: load, capacity |
| Timeline | Things that happen in order (a process, a history) | The line with the moments that matter | Rarely |
| Cycle | Something that comes back (water, a feedback loop) | The loop, and what speeds it up or slows it down | Sometimes |

Examples of each, already drawn, in references/examples/: the recipes (juros-fatura and pitagoras-telhado are measure and formula;
platao-caverna is a thought experiment; estoicismo-onibus is an argument; arquitetura-requisicao and arquitetura-fila
are systems).
